about: The Workbench icons of the CriticalMass drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is upstream's critter.png. CriticalMass-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, CriticalMass.info beside the program. ReadMe.info is also copied for the licence and upstream's Readme.html; Folder.info for data.
